messages:
Alex (AE): Hey team — Orchard Finance POC kickoff next Wed. They want streaming ingestion + function/tool calls for invoice parsing and structured JSON output. Need short checklist for the call: Node SDK snippet, streaming mode recommendation (SSE vs WebSocket), suggested batch/latency tradeoffs, auth pattern (short-lived creds + on-prem KMS?), and a ballpark pricing calc for ~1M tokens/mo. Can someone assemble a 10–15m runbook?
Maria (SE): I got this. @Jordan can you drop a minimal Node example and recommended default config? I'll own the handshake/runbook and liaise with Sam for security items. :thumbsup:
Jordan (SDK Eng): putting a quick example below — minimal, unopinionated. use SSE for lower overhead and easy reconnection.
Jordan (SDK Eng): ```js
// minimal Redwood streaming example (Node)
const { Redwood } = require('@redwood/inference')
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.RW_KEY })
const stream = client.stream({ model: 'redwood-chat-1', mode: 'sse', stream: true })
stream.on('message', (m) => {
  // server sends JSON deltas; final output should conform to your schema
  try { const obj = JSON.parse(m); console.log(obj) } catch(e) {}
})
// tool call envelope example:
/*
{ type: 'tool_call', tool: 'invoice_parser', input: { raw_text: '...' } }
*/
```
Jordan (SDK Eng): For throughput: start with batch_size=8, token_window=512; for low latency go down to batch_size=1 and use prefix/KV cache. If they do heavy concurrent streams, recommend dedicated or reserved capacity.
Alex (AE): Nice. Can you also show the structured schema we plan to validate against so we can demo deterministic mapping?
Jordan (SDK Eng): sure — simple JSON schema we demo in the UI: 
Jordan (SDK Eng): ```json
{
  "invoice_number": "string",
  "date": "string (ISO)",
  "total": "number",
  "currency": "string",
  "vendor": { "name": "string", "vat": "string?" },
  "items": [{ "description": "string", "qty": "number", "unit_price": "number" }]
}
```
Maria (SE): Great. I'll include sample validation code and an assert harness to catch regressions during the POC. Also adding a short checklist: 1) handshake + ephemeral creds sample, 2) streaming sample (SSE), 3) toolcall mapping example, 4) structured schema + validation, 5) runbook link, 6) pricing ballpark.
Sam (Security): Heads up — Orchard requires SAML SSO + EU-resident KMS and 7 year audit retention for transactions. For presales POC we can use short-lived credentials and a scoped audit stream, but need legal sign-off before touching real PHI. Also confirm whether logs include PII by default; we should prod the infra team for a logs-redaction toggle.
Ben (Solutions): I put together a short pricing ballpark for 1M tokens/mo: hosted API (mixed gen/embedding) ≈ $600–$900/mo. If they want reserved/dedicated for sustained throughput + SLA, add $6k–$12k/mo depending on GPU profile. These are rough; finance will validate. Also prepared a runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/orchard-poc (internal) — contains checklist + sample curl commands.
Alex (AE): Thanks. Can we get a staging env spun up with ephemeral creds for Monday? I'd like to demo end-to-end.
DeployBot: Deployed staging environment orchard-poc-staging at https://staging.orchard.redwood — creds emailed to alex@orchard.com (ephemeral, 24h).
Maria (SE): Perfect. I'll sync with Sam offline about KMS options and add the data-residency explainer to the deck.
Sam (Security): I'll draft the security appendix (SSO, KMS, audit logs, SOC2 checklist). Expect a short doc by EOD today.
Jordan (SDK Eng): One more note: for function/tool calls, the SDK sends a tool envelope — ensure the customer's parser returns the exact schema keys to avoid brittle mapping. We'll include a small adapter snippet in the runbook.
Ben (Solutions): I'll prep a 10-slide presales deck and include the pricing slide + tradeoffs (hosted vs reserved vs private).
Alex (AE): Awesome — team, please drop final runbook link and one-pager before EOD so I can share with the customer for the kickoff. :rocket:
Maria (SE): Will do.
Jordan (SDK Eng): Uploaded code sample + adapter to the runbook.
Sam (Security): Security appendix uploaded.
Ben (Solutions): Pricing slide uploaded.
Alex (AE): Thanks all, closing out.
